## Summary

Recover the remaining viewer artwork APIs from checkpoint47c7fa1.

```text
viewer instance → retained mounted clips → sized offscreen surface
               → uniform scale / local bounds / independent cleanup
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** artwork used a fixed350px surface and only creator layers.
  **After:** viewer instances have separate poses, configurable surface size, per-draw scale and explicit removal.
- Formatting, TypeScript,544 rule/parser tests (6,424 assertions), production build and all6 affected native/mock browser cases pass without skips. Existing default detail thumbnails and full-size selected previews remain verified.
- Same mount keys in separate rows retain independent clocks. Removing/recreating one resets only that row. Half-scale pixels keep the same local bounds; full-scale redraw matches earlier pixels. A600px surface paints an x230 mount beyond the former350px limit. Empty-row/fixture exit cleanup and repeated removal/destruction pass.
- Native/mock captures inspected. Original47 renderer APIs are recovered while retaining the already-landed inverse contact fix. Source Setup/Copy construct fresh images, Delete removes them, and detail transfer retains the existing image; eventual pane ownership wiring remains pending.
- Default creator size/bound lookup are unchanged. No React, profile, simulation, generated-data or media changes. Full live viewer layout/input/paint and controlled original-runtime comparison remain subsequent work.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes unused viewer APIs; no migration.

**Blast Radius:** artwork

Shared creator renderer gains optional parameters with existing defaults preserved.

## Summary

Recover the viewer's pane ownership and source fade queues.

```text
card → detail: transfer the same preview; fade/delete card shells
Back → cards: create fresh previews; fade/delete old detail
Update: input flags → signed alpha step → later normalization/deletion
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** the incremental branch had no pane/fade model; the preserved helper changed input early and clamped decimal alpha.
  **After:** seven source regressions fail against that helper and pass with queue-only show/hide and the existing signed8.8 display-value model.
- Formatting, TypeScript,554 rule/parser tests (6,512 assertions) and production build pass. Ten new cases protect ownership transfer, fresh Back/page/detail previews, queue reversal, neighbor deferral, overshoot/normalization and synchronous pending deletion during rapid Back.
- Pane ownership matches original47c7fa1 byte-for-byte. Decompiled _-KT/_-Lv and pcode confirm detach/push only; Update changes mouseEnabled and increments forward after splice. Delete fades retain flags until their disposal callback.
- Alpha reuses the project's display-values model, supported by Ruffle Fixed8 implementation evidence. Controlled Adobe runtime equality remains unproven. Later code-entry cancellation and local provenance/save work remain separate backlog slices.
- No current browser flow consumes these pure models. Live pane/artwork/input wiring, caller-specific flags and complete viewer/game parity remain pending. No browser server, profile, media, generated-data or simulation changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes unconnected models/tests. No migration.

**Blast Radius:** viewer

Adds pure state/ownership logic.
